description: Tier-1 workflow definition source for a DX-bound workspace form. Source-ready; DX must bind the credentialRef and artifact pins before execution.

persistence.note: The portable source stores a credentialRef, never a deployment-local credential id or secret. DX/workflow worker must resolve it to a same-org Tier-2 API-key credential before execution.

credentialBinding.resolvedTo: per-organization technical owner-only encrypted api-key credential
credentialBinding.exportRebinding: DX export rewrites the bound deployment credential into the portable source reference; no id or secret is written to the repository
credentialBinding.runtimeChecksum: DX verifies the artifact graph checksum/revision pins at execution

persistence.transitionTransport: httpRequest GET(includeInput:true) -> code merge/invariant check -> PATCH full data with ifVersion

pluginWidgetBinding.note: Portable bundles cannot carry environment-specific artifact ids or pins. DX binds them at import/install/publish.

deploymentGate: Do not activate or deploy until the credential binding, artifact pinning, and engine test on the deployment are verified. Tier-3 pages stay live until then.

createsBefore.idempotent: existing orders (by deterministic id or plan.order_ids) are skipped

workflows.contentGuard: a snapshot, summary or reporting period must exist before publishing

modeByStatus.draft: append the computed delta entry and PATCH
modeByStatus.review_pending: append the computed delta entry and PATCH
modeByStatus.published: create a new draft revision that amends the published record
modeByStatus.archived: create a new draft revision that amends the archived record

delta.diffBase: the amended base revision when amends_sitrep_id is set, else the current record

structure.changed_fields: [{field, from, to}] for every submitted value that really differs
structure.to_revision: the append target (current) or the new revision number

delta.emptyGuard: sitrep_delta_empty when no submitted value differs from the base

releaseCompensation.trigger: a terminal order that still holds the reservation releases it before refusing (order_terminal)
releaseCompensation.engineLimit: the Tier-1 graph has no error branch, so an order PATCH that fails after a fresh reservation fails the run loudly; a retry re-enters through the already-reserved idempotent path

engineContract.note: Credential-backed httpRequest nodes declare an exact destination origin allowlist. The workflow worker must keep allowedOrigins pinned when it binds credentialRef.

dispatch.merge: GET(includeInput:true) -> validate state -> merge patch over full record -> PATCH {data,ifVersion}

invariants: completed/canceled/rejected orders cannot be re-completed
an order must have an assigned_resource_unit_id (or a legacy assignment with the same id) before completion
completed_at is captured once in the validation node
a completed/canceled order cannot be rejected again
the assignment history is preserved by the full-record merge
the AAR draft is created before the event PATCH
a resolved event is idempotent: no AAR and no event write
an existing AAR for the event is reused instead of duplicated
the AAR event_end and the event ended_at are the same close timestamp
a stale ifVersion returns 409 version_conflict and fails the run
approve/publish/submit read the Tier-2 approvals record and require status=approved, matching entityId and action=eop.approve
four-eyes: the operator who requested the approval can never consume it (self_approval_forbidden)
publish requires the same approval that admitted the plan (plan.approval_id) and only an approved plan
submit refuses a published plan (publication is a terminal lifecycle step) and only submits an approved one
submit seeds deterministic dispatch orders from the plan actions and skips existing ones
the static Tier-1 graph creates at most 20 missing orders per run and fails closed before any write beyond that
a published or archived SITREP is refused (sitrep_already_published); publication is the only path to the published status
content guard: a snapshot, summary or reporting period must exist (sitrep_content_required)
only review_pending may be published (sitrep_review_required)
a delta against a published/archived SITREP creates a new draft revision with amends_sitrep_id instead of mutating history
a delta entry must carry a real changed-fields diff with revision numbers; a no-op is refused with sitrep_delta_empty
a stale ifVersion returns 409 version_conflict and fails the run

patch.assignments: appended {dispatch_order_id, resource_unit_id, assigned_resource_unit_id, assigned_user_id, assigned_at, assigned_by} unless duplicated

invariants: the workflow reads the Tier-2 approvals record and requires status=approved, entityId=order and action=dispatch.assign
four-eyes: the approval requester can never be the executing operator
the unit is reserved first (status=assigned, assigned_dispatch_order_id) and the reservation survives the responder progression
a terminal order that still holds the reservation releases it before refusing (compensation release)
an already-assigned order with the same unit is idempotent; a different unit is refused with order_already_assigned
a stale ifVersion returns 409 version_conflict and fails the run
start only from assigned; arrive only from in_transit (the fixed route table at routes:1374-1375)
started_at/arrived_at are captured once and the transition is appended to status_history
the reservation is never released by a progression step; only a terminal order releases its unit
an order already in the target state is idempotent without any write

aarInvariants.versionSource: highest existing AAR version for the event (next version only when regenerating; close reuses the latest)
aarInvariants.summaryParity: same three legacy sentences as apps/sos-service computeAfterAction
aarInvariants.inputBounds: queries request limit 500 (Tier-2 max page size); total > page fails the run with query_truncated_<collection>; AAR list is ordered version:desc

genericActionWorkflow.description: Declarative create/update/delete/execute dispatcher for organization workspace forms. The DX published-plugin binding pins revision and checksum; fields, datasets and statuses are product-owned allowlists.
